messages:
tayla: FYI users reported intermittent SSE stalls after yesterday's routing-policy tweak. Rate of client reconnects up ~0.4% for a subset of EU routes.

lee: saw that. spikes correlate with proxy TTL refreshes (proxy-shard-09 returning 204 on keepalive). suspect idle-ttl vs server-side keepalive mismatch.

tayla: logs show client saw `event: close
` then reconnect. server logs show: 
```
proxy-09 WARN keepalive stale session id=tn-77 route=eu-west shard=proxy-09 ttl=30s last-ping=45s
streamer-21 INFO session-close reason=idle-timeout sess=xyz123 last_activity=2024-05-14T12:04:10Z
```

owen: does console alert on tenant-level silent-close counts? current alert is only for hard errors, not soft idle disconnects. we should differentiate.

lee: routing policy change bumped some traffic off sticky routes into pooled proxies to even load. pooled proxies have shorter idle TTL to free sockets. that mismatch probably causes midstream `close` followed by client reconnect -> duplicate billing traces.

tayla: mitigation options: 1) extend pooled-proxy idle TTL to match streamer keepalive OR 2) make streamer emit a `keepalive-ping` every 20s for pooled proxies OR 3) change routing policy to honor affinity for long-lived sessions.

owen: prefer (2) as minimal ops change. but need metrics so we can surface impacted tenants pre-rollout: `stream.disconnect.soft` tagged by route_id + `stream.session.duration_bucket`.

lee: i'll add metric hooks and heatmap to the console: soft-disconnects by route and by tenant. add an alert: page if tenant soft-disconnect >0.3% over 10m and >200 sessions. else post to #eng-runtime.

tayla: also need a rollout UX change: if changing routing policy that affects affinity, require a checklist item to confirm session keepalive/TTL parity and emit `stream.session.affinity` metric.

deploy-bot: config change: routing-policy v1.9 -> pool-shard-fanout-hotfix at 13:05 by lee.

alert-bot: new alert registered: soft-sse-disconnects-high at 13:12.

lee: pushing metric patch to canary: streamer will emit `stream.disconnect.soft` and `stream.session.affinity` tags. hotfix will also add extra keepalive ping for pooled proxies.

owen: scheduling a short load test: 10k long-lived SSE clients against pooled proxies to ensure no dup billing + <0.1% reconnects.

tayla: good. add a console readout: rolling-rollback button visible when any routing-policy change lacks parity checkbox. small UX note for PMs.

deploy-bot: canary rollout: streamer-keepalive-patch -> canary-cluster (10%) at 13:27.

alert-bot: firing: soft-sse-disconnects-high (canary) 13:33 rate 0.45% (5m) route=eu-west shard=proxy-09.

lee: looks like metric tag shows high soft disconnects specifically on proxy-09 which still has TTL=30s; patch added pings but proxies might be dropping pre-parse.

owen: can we query proxy logs for `FIN` vs `RST` to tell if proxies gracefully closed? quick snippet: 
```bash
kubectl exec -it proxy-09 -- tail -n 200 /var/log/proxy/access.log | grep FIN | wc -l
```

lee: digging. also adding obfuscated `proxy_pool` id to logs to map to routing policy.

tayla: if canary stays >0.3% for 20m, we'll pause rollout and revert routing-policy change.

alert-bot: resolved: soft-sse-disconnects-high (canary) at 14:05 rate down to 0.09% (5m).

lee: confirmed root cause: proxy TTL misconfigured on one fleet after autoscale template drift. fixed template and re-deployed pooled proxies. 

owen: ran validation job: 10k clients -> reconnects 0.06% and no duplicate billing traces.

tayla: follow-ups: add automated check during routing-policy changes to compare proxy TTL vs streamer keepalive and block the rollout if mismatch; record in rollout page that `stream.session.affinity` metric must be emitted for affinity changes.

lee: PRs: routing infra patch + console alert + streamer metric patch. links in ticket: https://git/redwood/routing/pull/237 and https://git/redwood/streamer/pull/238

tayla: thanks all. closing thread.
